tara_cs: Drafting a one-page "lightning" runbook for BlueFin kickoff tomorrow — cache/batch/stream + quick checks. Please poke holes.

leo_sre: Nice and short please. Add owner for telemetry.

tara_cs: RUNBOOK (one pager)
- TL;DR: cache-first for repeat prompts, batch for bursty microcalls, streaming for live UI. Keep a clear rollback trigger.

- Pre-launch checks:
  - Warm pool >= expected TPS for first 90m (start 1.2x if unsure).
  - Telemetry owner: platform-observability (validate latency, 5xx, cache-hit-rate).

- Cache rules:
  - Use prefix cache when >25% identical starts. TTLs: 5-15m for session content, 12-24h for static prompts.
  - Recommend stale-while-revalidate to avoid UX stalls.
  - Quick curl test: second identical POST should return header x-cache: HIT.

- Batching knobs:
  - For many small requests (<150 tokens) enable batching. Start window=10ms, maxWindow=75ms. MaxBatch: 64 (big GPUs) / 32 (small).

- Streaming tips:
  - Flush partial tokens every 50ms or on boundary. If stream fails, retry once after 200ms then fall back non-stream.

- Rollback trigger:
  - If p95 latency >2x baseline for 3m, set cache TTL=0 and reduce batch window to 5ms.

anya_eng: Add note to run a small probe traffic during business hours so we can tune.

ops-bot: Docs updated in repo at commit c3a9f1.

tara_cs: Thanks all — I'll attach this to the invite and collect their chosen TTLs in the follow-up thread.
